'''Fonio''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|fonio flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|fonio beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] fonio plants for their ''grain''.
